description: This file contains unit tests for the VerhoeffIdentifierValidator class, which validates identifiers using the Verhoeff checksum algorithm. The tests cover valid and invalid inputs, suffix validation, check digit calculations, and transposition detection.

classes.name: VerhoeffIdentifierValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for VerhoeffIdentifierValidator, testing identifier validation logic and check digit calculations.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier_shouldGetValidIdentifier
methods.description: Tests that valid identifiers return the expected formatted identifier with check digit.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier_shouldFailWithInvalidIdentifiers
methods.description: Ensures invalid identifiers throw exceptions with appropriate messages.

methods.name: isValid_shouldFailWithInvalidIdentifiers
methods.description: Verifies that invalid identifiers cause the isValid method to throw exceptions.

methods.name: isValid_shouldFailWithInvalidSuffixes
methods.description: Tests that identifiers with invalid suffixes (non-conforming check digit suffixes) cause exceptions.

methods.name: isValid_shouldPassWithValidSuffixes
methods.description: Checks that valid identifiers with correct suffix check digits return true.

methods.name: isValid_shouldFailWithIncorrectlyCalculatedSuffixes
methods.description: Asserts that identifiers with wrong check digit suffixes are marked invalid.

methods.name: isValid_shouldFailWithNumericSuffixes
methods.description: Ensures numeric suffixes that are not expected throw exceptions.

methods.name: checkDigit_shouldChangeWhenAdjacentCharsAreTransposed
methods.description: Verifies that transposing adjacent characters in an identifier results in a different check digit, detecting transposition errors.
